name: PR detail Files changed tab groups the seeded diff by Smart Diff role
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm the Smart Diff grouping renders a role label, a seeded core file (src/middleware/ratelimit.ts), and the Smart/Original order toggle. Read-only seeded data (no model call); #482 has no lock file or patch text, so this proves grouping, ordering, and the toggle's presence only, not collapse, the lock-file rule, or switching to Original order. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
